title: Amended: Transaction Monitoring Thresholds (32023R0956)
raw_content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<RESULTS>
  <NOTICE>
    <CELEX>32023R0956</CELEX>
    <TITLE lang="EN">Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/2156 on transaction monitoring thresholds</TITLE>
    <DATE_DOCUMENT>2024-09-01</DATE_DOCUMENT>
    <EFFECTIVE_DATE>2024-10-01</EFFECTIVE_DATE>
    <CONTENTS>Article 2(1) - Enhanced monitoring threshold: EUR 5,000 per single transaction (previously EUR 10,000). Article 2(3) - Aggregate monitoring threshold: EUR 15,000 per calendar month per customer (previously EUR 25,000). Article 3(2) - Monitoring rules review frequency: semi-annually (previously annually). Article 4 - SAR review deadline: 24 hours from alert generation (previously 48 hours). Article 5 - Data retention: 7 years (previously 5 years). These amendments apply from 1 October 2024.</CONTENTS>
  </NOTICE>
</RESULTS>
